reviews.summary: This is a very old stock joke (the 'prisoner in a fortune cookie factory' gag) that appears on every list for this search. It is the one line here that could sit on any other site. The replacement is new and works at a party table.; This is a near-duplicate of the line just above it ('A long and happy future awaits you. I would like to be in it.'). Repeating the same idea makes the list look padded, and the reader notices.

Template.tsx doesn't enforce an order. The real cookie (index total-1, marked ✨) can be tapped at any point, its slip shows s.last, and tapping the slip goes straight to the finale. The current line suggests it only opens after the others, and the post's 'put the sweet one last' advice would fail in the template because a fortune's content is tied to the cookie's position, not to the order they're opened.; The same accuracy problem in Spanish. 'Cuando ha abierto todas' also has no clear subject.; 'Go to the shop' reads British. VOICE.md asks for wording that works for US and UK readers alike.;

This is the biggest sub-intent in the SERP ('funny fortune cookie sayings for boyfriend', 'love fortunes'), and the post's own FAQ already asks about 'a boyfriend or girlfriend'. The heading should use the words people search with, not 'partner'.; Same fix in Spanish. People search 'frases ... galletas de la fortuna para mi novio/novia', and the ES FAQ already says 'para mi novio o mi novia'.
